description: N54 append-only, owner-scoped action journal feed. Record IDs are actual simple primary-key text (UUID, numeric or legacy text), or JSON text for composite PKs. The cursor is per-owner commit-ordered and retention watermarks require replay/reset; the service-role 30-day pruning helper runs daily from the pg_cron job lemma-prune-owner-changes (#1216).
